summary.scope: Ten-fold sampled conditional-DNA DeepLIFT and saturation mutagenesis: 2000 held-out genes/DNA groups, 50 original A/FiLM checkpoints, no training or ChIP alteration. Not all 15351 genes or independent biological validation.
summary.inference_readout: Original-scale signed pooled Y_PC1, mutant minus WT, five-seed prediction average
summary.interpretation: Exploratory model-internal association. SNPs dependent; fold training sets overlap. No biological causality, binding validation, accuracy improvement, RNA logFC or full-gene OOF claim.
summary.prior_confirmation: Fold1-selected motif labels, not same genes repeated or forced motif rediscovery; absent is not zero effect.
